drivers: Mixed refinery outages and restarts (Deer Park outage vs Flint Hills, Valero restarts)
Petcoke rally above US$100 and higher freight rates
outlooks.summary: Refinery news is mixed: some outages, but several units have restarted. The rally above US$100 and higher freight add some support, but the price is down 16% in 3 months and the supply score is near zero.
outlooks.watch_next: Watch how long the Deer Park outage lasts and whether freight rates keep limiting US Gulf coke exports.
outlooks.summary_zh: 炼厂消息好坏参半:有停产,但多套装置已重启。石油焦突破100美元的上涨和运费走高提供一定支撑,但价格3个月下跌16%,供应压力评分接近零。
drivers_zh: 炼厂停产与重启并存(Deer Park停产,Flint Hills、Valero重启)
石油焦涨至100美元上方,运费上升
outlooks.watch_next_zh: 关注Deer Park炼厂停产持续时间,以及运费是否继续限制美湾石油焦出口。

drivers: DRC export quotas cutting output (Glencore cobalt output down 52%)
China export-control deadlines and critical mineral tightness
outlooks.summary: DRC quotas are sharply cutting supply, and China's export-control uncertainty adds risk. The 3-month price fall suggests the market has not fully priced this in, though the 12-month gain is large.
outlooks.watch_next: Watch DRC quota adjustments and any change to China's export-control pause.
outlooks.summary_zh: 刚果(金)配额大幅削减供应,中国出口管制的不确定性增加风险。价格3个月下跌说明市场可能尚未完全消化这些因素,但12个月涨幅已较大。
drivers_zh: 刚果(金)出口配额压减产量(嘉能可钴产量下降52%)
中国出口管制期限及关键矿产紧张
outlooks.watch_next_zh: 关注刚果(金)配额调整以及中国出口管制暂停安排的变化。

drivers: Copper-moly major slows molybdenum output growth
Price up 18% in 3 months and 42% in 12 months
outlooks.summary: Slower output growth from a major producer and China export-control risk point to tight supply. Prices have already risen sharply, so part of the shortage may be priced in.
outlooks.watch_next: Watch China's export-control decisions and producer output guidance.
outlooks.summary_zh: 大型生产商放缓钼产量增长,加上中国出口管制风险,供应偏紧。但价格已大幅上涨,部分短缺可能已被计入价格。
drivers_zh: 铜钼大型企业放缓钼产量增长
outlooks.watch_next_zh: 关注中国出口管制决定及生产商产量指引。

outlooks.summary: Policy risk from China is a supportive factor, but there are no lithium-specific outages. New upstream projects and a weaker 3-month price point to a balanced view.
outlooks.watch_next: Watch China's export-control moves and lithium supply restarts or new project news.
outlooks.summary_zh: 中国政策风险提供支撑,但没有锂行业自身的停产消息。上游新项目和3个月价格走弱,整体偏中性。
drivers_zh: 中国出口管制不确定性
新增上游产能(宁德时代雅安项目)
outlooks.watch_next_zh: 关注中国出口管制动向以及锂供应复产或新项目消息。

drivers: Yttrium supply to Japan has stalled
China extended export-control pause by two months only
outlooks.summary: Yttrium shortages in Japan show real physical tightness. China's two-month pause eases near-term risk but ends in January, so the risk comes back.
outlooks.watch_next: Watch China's January decision on export controls and yttrium shipments to Japan.
outlooks.summary_zh: 日本钇短缺显示实物供应确实偏紧。中国将管制暂停期仅延长两个月,短期风险缓解,但1月到期后风险重现。
drivers_zh: 中国仅将出口管制暂停延长两个月
outlooks.watch_next_zh: 关注中国1月份对出口管制的决定以及对日本的钇出货情况。

drivers: Congo conflict and Indonesia supply cuts
outlooks.summary: Supply disruption in Congo and Indonesia, plus demand outpacing supply, supports further upside. The price is already up strongly over 12 months, but it was flat over 3 months.
outlooks.watch_next: Watch Congo conflict developments and Indonesian export volumes.
outlooks.summary_zh: 刚果(金)和印尼的供应中断,加上需求增速超过精炼锡供应,支持进一步上行。12个月涨幅已很大,但近3个月基本持平。
drivers_zh: 刚果(金)冲突与印尼减产
需求增长超过精炼锡供应
outlooks.watch_next_zh: 关注刚果(金)冲突进展和印尼出口量。

outlooks.summary: An approaching export deadline adds some upside risk, but the details are vague. The price is down sharply over 12 months, which suggests ample supply for now.
outlooks.watch_next: Watch the export deadline outcome and any new Chinese controls.
outlooks.summary_zh: 出口期限临近带来一定上行风险,但细节不明确。价格12个月大幅下跌,显示当前供应较充裕。
outlooks.watch_next_zh: 关注出口期限结果及中国是否出台新管制。

drivers: Rising indium prices and tight by-product supply
outlooks.summary: Export-control deadlines and tight by-product supply point to more upside risk. Prices have already jumped 67% in 3 months, so part of the shortage is priced in.
outlooks.watch_next: Watch China's November 27 deadline and any licence changes.
outlooks.summary_zh: 出口管制期限和副产品供应紧张意味着更多上行风险。价格3个月已大涨67%,部分短缺已被计入价格。
drivers_zh: 中国出口管制期限(镓为11月27日)
铟价上涨、副产品供应紧张
outlooks.watch_next_zh: 关注中国11月27日的期限及许可政策变化。

outlooks.summary: Refinery news is mixed, and the supply score is near zero. Higher anode costs and freight support prices, but the 15% rise suggests much of this is priced in.
outlooks.watch_next: Watch the Deer Park outage and green coke price trends.
outlooks.summary_zh: 炼厂消息好坏参半,供应压力评分接近零。阳极成本和运费上升提供支撑,但价格已涨15%,部分利好可能已被计入。
outlooks.watch_next_zh: 关注Deer Park炼厂停产情况以及生焦价格走势。

outlooks.summary: Headlines are mixed and the supply score is near zero. Freight issues add some support, but the 3-month price is slightly lower.
outlooks.watch_next: Watch refinery outage durations and freight rates.
outlooks.summary_zh: 消息好坏参半,供应压力评分接近零。运费问题提供一定支撑,但近3个月价格略有下降。
outlooks.watch_next_zh: 关注炼厂停产持续时间和运费水平。
